essence: Engagement with the sacred text should occur in a place adorned with scattered flowers and incense.
A pure person may write, hear, or read the sacred teaching.
The knowledge of Shiva has become lost over time and weakened in authoritative form.
The reading of Shiva knowledge has been neglected and destroyed by people of limited understanding.
The corrupted text contains useless words and meaningless repetition.
